original_request: Re-engage lapsed luxury customers in DE via SMS for Black Friday
assumptions: 'Lapsed' → no order since 2025-11-28 (6 months before intake date 2026-05-28). If team measures 'lapsed' from send date (2026-11-27), recompute cutoff to 2026-05-27.
Mapped 'lapsed' audience descriptor to At-Risk customer_segment (CRM-native tag).
Restricted to account_status = active to avoid sending to inactive/suspended accounts.
Send window defaulted to single-day local-time 09:00-20:00 CET on Black Friday 2026 (2026-11-27).
Defaulted success_metric to 'clicks' and approver to 'Marketing Ops'.
Default frequency_cap: 1 send per customer per 7 days; additionally suppress anyone contacted in last 7 days.
open_questions: Confirm: 'lapsed' window anchored to intake date vs send date? Used intake-date anchor per option label.
Confirm: include customers in DE whose preferred_channel is not SMS? Recommend yes — preferred is a hint, not a consent gate.
Confirm: SCC for Klaviyo EU->US transfer already in place, or does DPO need to sign off pre-send?
human_summary: Re-engage active At-Risk customers in DE with LTV >= 500 EUR and no order since 2025-11-28, via SMS through Klaviyo on Black Friday 2026 (Nov 27, 09:00-20:00 CET). Lawful basis: marketing consent (sms_opt_in required). Always excludes unsubscribed, erasure-requested, consent-withdrawn; additionally suppresses anyone contacted in the last 7 days. Three open questions: lapsed anchor (intake vs send date), include non-SMS-preferred customers, Klaviyo SCC sign-off.
